summary: Creatives' code is unchanged since the first audit (no cr* file differs between 56b1a8c and this kos-redraw-1 checkout), and all 24 earlier findings still reproduce on this build; the background-redraw stopgap does not help the Practice Log dialog because its stacking is caused by explicit KOS.rerender() calls. The inventory pass found the most important new defect in the evidence model: a theory card rated in the lesson's own Theory cards tab never reaches the shared progress record, because KOS.creatives.syncAll() is defined but never called, so lessons stall at 75% and the inspector, desk and spine disagree (P1). Several settings and rewards promise more than they do: the Minutes setting is never read, drills pay with no interaction, projects pay for three taps and re-promise pay after Undo, and Writing saves count the given setup text and double taps. Touch sizing is the recurring presentation root cause (check choices, pairing and Bold chips, lab zoom at 24-32 px), together with iPhone page-title and card-title handling. Integration gaps: Creatives work is not searchable, free pieces added from 'Add your work' belong to no track and so never reach goals or Reports.
coverage: Build kos-redraw-1 (2e40f2b), harness slot 12, empty account (reset) and dense account (seed + 26-38 planted works via cr2/plant.js), sizes mac 1470x832, iPad 820x1180, iPad landscape 1180x820, iPhone 402x874; themes Graphite, Atelier Dawn (settings contrast 4.99:1, log page), azure-butterfly shop theme (check page). DOM measurement sweeps over 23 routes x 3 sizes empty and 12 routes x 3 sizes dense (+8 at iPad landscape): cr2/empty-*.json, cr2/dense-*.json, cr2/l-ipadl-*.json. Inventory matrix with per-item result: findings/creatives.inventory.md. Behaviour fixtures run: evidence/pay (cr2/b1.js: read, save, pass/fail/pass-again, card via srs.rate, delete, re-add, drills), card via the Theory cards tab UI, notes dwell (2.5 s / Next 1.5 s), settings planDay (days, minutes, rest, all-off), all six drills end to end plus a drill from a study, Add your work (8 input cases through the real form with DataTransfer files), Practice Log delete via UI (confirm focuses Cancel) and promote/take-out, project taps/undo/redo, Writing Desk duplicate draft / double save / unchanged save, critique dialog (opens, Cancel focused, five sections) and stray() on 8 replies, Momentum toggle (toolbar becomes Pen only, persists), global search. NOT checked: the critique Send/Keep/Pin path (needs a live provider; no network request was made), the sketchbook's Save after drawing and leaving with unsaved ink (synthetic pointer events did not draw on the ink surface), Reports' creativeFacts and the month Portfolio strip at runtime (KOS.report.gather signature not resolved; logic read in report.js:644-665 and reports.js:984), cloud merge of state.creatives and the kurenai-os-creatives backup round trip (code read only: store.js:577-580, :703), the Daily Creative 'clear', 'project' and cards-only states (code read only, js/modules/creatives.js:175-190), Editing track (no released units). Old findings: all 24 carried with recheck; titles unchanged.

findings.title: Practice Log work dialog reopens itself after every action and stacks on each redraw (#/creatives/log/<id>)
findings.detail: Saving from the Writing Desk, a drill or Add your work lands on #/creatives/log/<id>, whose render schedules openWork(id). Any KOS.rerender() while that route is current (the dialog's own 'Take out of Portfolio', the Promote dialog's 'Promote', or any background redraw) draws the page again and opens the work dialog AGAIN. Repro: go to #/creatives, then #/creatives/log/<id>; click 'Take out of Portfolio' -> the dialog closes and immediately re-opens (now showing 'Promote…'). KOS.rerender() with it open -> two identical stacked dialogs (10 buttons). The route never drops the id, so the user cannot act on the work without it bouncing back.
findings.evidence: eval: after cr.promote click count of [data-ui="cr.dialog"] stays 1 with button now 'Promote…'; after KOS.rerender() count 1 -> 2; js/modules/creatives.js:567 'if (wid && CR().work(wid)) setTimeout(function () { openWork(wid); }, 0);' inside logPage; :542 and :559 call d.close(); KOS.rerender(); landing routes js/modules/crwrite.js:147, crdrills.js:85, creatives.js:620 | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval cr2/rc1.js on kos-redraw-1: Promote -> dialog count 1 with 'Take out of Portfolio'; explicit KOS.rerender() -> 2 dialogs; navigation to #/creatives/portfolio and #/home -> still 2 (the redraw stopgap only holds BACKGROUND redraws; an explicit rerender still stacks)
findings.fix: Open the deep-linked dialog only on navigation, not on redraw (check KOS.ui.redrawing / a one-shot flag), and after opening replace the route with #/creatives/log (KOS.show with replace) or clear the id when the dialog closes; the row's open state can stay as a highlight.
findings.rootCause: Render-time side effect: logPage opens a dialog from the route arg on every render, and the route keeps the id.
findings.recheck: holds — eval cr2/rc1.js on kos-redraw-1: Promote -> dialog count 1 with 'Take out of Portfolio'; explicit KOS.rerender() -> 2 dialogs; navigation to #/creatives/portfolio and #/home -> still 2 (the redraw stopgap only holds BACKGROUND redraws; an explicit rerender still stacks)

findings.title: On iPhone, Creatives settings (and Start focus) cannot be reached: the gear lives in the page actions, which the phone shell hides
findings.detail: The ⚙ 'Creatives settings' button and 'Start focus' are put in #page-actions by spaceHead/KOS.shell.actions. Under 700 px the stage head is display:none and only nodes marked data-phone-action are moved into the phone title bar; neither button is marked, and the section switch menu lists only Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives, A-levels, Tracks, Writing, Drills, References, Portfolio. So on the iPhone there is no way to change Your days, Minutes or the Exam Season pause (which hides the Daily Creative for weeks) except by typing #/creatives/settings.

findings.title: Rating a Creatives theory card never ticks the lesson's fourth check: syncAll() exists but nothing calls it, so mastery stays at 75% and the lesson never completes
findings.detail: A lesson's fourth check ('A theory card held') is derived from the card's schedule, but it reaches the shared progress record only when KOS.creatives.syncChecks(lesson) runs, and that is called only from markPage, addWork, setCheck and removeWork. The function meant to catch a card rated in the flashcards engine, KOS.creatives.syncAll() (comment: 'a theory card rated elsewhere ticks its lesson's fourth check'), is exported but never called anywhere in js/. So a learner who reads, saves and passes every study and then reviews the theory cards in Review/Due sees the lesson stuck at 75%, never 'Completed', the unit never done, and the desk's Lessons tile not moving, until they happen to save or check another piece in that lesson. Repro (empty account): read W1.1's pages, save and pass both studies -> progress check '1110'; KOS.srs.rate('creatives:W1.1:0',3) -> KOS.creatives.evidence('W1.1').checks = [T,T,T,T] but progress still '1110', KOS.hub.leafPercent = 75; only a later addWork on W1.1 flips it to '1111' / done. Through the real UI: on #/ref/creatives/W1.3 with pages read and both studies passed (progress '1110'), opening the Theory cards tab and pressing Good on a card -> evidence '1111' but progress '1110', KOS.hub.leafPercent 75, and the inspector still reads '3 of 4 checks' (the flashcards engine dispatches no kos:cr-evidence, so the status panel never redraws). The inspector computes from live evidence while the desk ring, spine, unit cards and Lessons tile read the progress record, so the surfaces disagree (invariant 26d). Cards are usually the LAST thing done in a lesson, so in practice there is no later action to heal it.
findings.evidence: eval fixture audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/cr2/b1.js: afterPass '1110:started', cardHeld true, evidence [true,true,true,true], afterCard '1110:started', leafPct 75; grep -rn 'syncAll' js -> only js/core/creatives.js:247 (definition) and :481 (export); js/core/creatives.js:240-247; UI repro eval on #/ref/creatives/W1.3: before '1110', Theory cards tab -> Good -> after '1110', evAfter '1111', inspector '3 of 4 checks', leaf 75
findings.fix: Call KOS.creatives.syncChecks for the card's lesson whenever a key starting 'creatives:' is rated (a hook in KOS.srs.rate like Code/Mind's syncConcept, or a 'kos-srs-rated' event), and run syncAll() once at boot to repair stuck lessons.
findings.rootCause: The fourth check depends on another domain's record (the card schedule) but has no change hook; the repair function was written but never wired.

findings.title: A work dialog stays open over other pages after navigation (Back, hash change), stacking duplicates
findings.detail: With the work dialog open on #/creatives/log/<id>, navigating to #/creatives/portfolio or #/home leaves the dialog (and its scrim) covering the new page; returning to the deep link opens a second copy. During the measurement run three copies of a deleted work's dialog were stacked over Portfolio. Browser Back / iPad edge-swipe therefore does not dismiss the dialog the way a user expects (invariant 64: browser chrome and OS gestures are one stack).
findings.evidence: eval: [cr.dialog] count 1 after location.hash='#/creatives/portfolio', 2 after returning to log/<id>, still 2 on #/home; shots/creatives/n/dense-mac-portfolio.png (first capture: dialog of a removed work over Portfolio); js/core/ui.js:155 openDialog has no navigation hook; js/core/router.js:302 hashchange handler does not close open dialogs | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval cr2/rc1.js: dialogs 2 after location.hash='#/creatives/portfolio', 2 on #/home
findings.fix: In router.js, before rendering a navigation (not a redraw), close every open KOS.ui dialog (or have openDialog register a close on the next route change); keep it out of KOS.rerender.
findings.rootCause: KOS.ui.openDialog dialogs are not tied to the route; the router never closes them.
findings.recheck: holds — eval cr2/rc1.js: dialogs 2 after location.hash='#/creatives/portfolio', 2 on #/home

findings.title: Creatives desk hero is taller than the other study spaces' heroes (341 vs 292-339 px) and its analytics card is stretched with empty bands
findings.detail: At 1470x832 the desk-top row is 341 px for Creatives vs Code 292, Mind 296, Japanese 339: four track bars in the hero push it taller than Code/Mind, so the study-space heroes are not one size. The second row is worse: the 'Subject analytics' card is 378 px tall (253 px on Code, Japanese and Mind) because it stretches to the Portfolio side card; its two tile rows are 163 px apart instead of 100, leaving a ~60 px empty band under each value.

findings.title: Settings 'Your days': the S M T W T F S letters sit at the left edge of their circles, and on touch the circles are 40x44 ovals
findings.detail: Every day button's letter is 12-15 px left of centre at all three sizes (text-align inherits 'start'). On iPad and iPhone (pointer: coarse) the shared touch rule raises only the height to 44 px, so each 40 px circle becomes a 40x44 oval, which invariant 69 forbids ('a round control must raise its width too').

findings.title: A Writing study's '▶ Start' (and a project's 'Write it') makes a NEW draft every time instead of reopening the unfinished one
findings.detail: Start a Writing study, type, leave without 'Save to Practice Log', come back to the lesson: the study card still says '▶ Start' and pressing it creates a second draft from the setup text, so the user lands on a fresh page and their writing seems gone (it is only in the drafts list). Same for 'Write it' on a Writing project milestone. Pressing Start twice produced two identical 'W1.1·a Ten things, ten sentences' drafts.
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.crWrite.openStudy('W1.1','a') twice -> #/creatives/write/mvzi1k0viya1 and #/creatives/write/mvzi1lmk5f7t; drafts list shows two identical rows; js/modules/crwrite.js:34-43 (openStudy/openMilestone always create()); js/modules/crtopic.js:40 and :71-72 (study card offers only '▶ Start'/'Another rep'); js/modules/creatives.js:601 | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval: openStudy('W2.2','a') twice -> #/creatives/write/mw7l5pwfdtd7 and /mw7l5qmybfra, drafts 2 -> 4

findings.title: A Writing study can be 'saved' with only the given setup text: the untouched 80% counts as made work
findings.detail: openStudy pre-fills the draft with the study's setup. Save only checks that the textarea is non-empty, so pressing ▶ Start then 'Save to Practice Log' without writing a word records a 49-word work, ticks 'studies saved' for the lesson and leads straight to the self-marked check that pays 8 XP/1 gold. That contradicts invariant 154 ('creative evidence is made, not claimed').
findings.evidence: eval: draft opened by KOS.crWrite.openStudy('W1.1','a') saved unchanged -> work 'W1.1·a Ten things, ten sentences' words 49; js/modules/crwrite.js:36-39 (text: s.setup) and :139 (only area.value.trim() checked) | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval: W2.2·a saved unchanged -> work 31 words; shots/creatives/t/write-mac.png shows the study's own instruction ('Every sentence below is about the same length…') inside the draft, so it is saved, counted and sent to a critique; the 'Write words' goal (goals.js:762-768) counts it
findings.fix: Refuse to save (toast 'Write your part first') while the text still equals the setup, or count only words beyond the setup (store setup length on the doc and use it for words/the guard).
findings.recheck: holds — eval: W2.2·a saved unchanged -> work 31 words; shots/creatives/t/write-mac.png shows the study's own instruction ('Every sentence below is about the same length…') inside the draft, so it is saved, counted and sent to a critique; the 'Write words' goal (goals.js:762-768) counts it

findings.title: Writing Desk drafts cannot be deleted or tidied: every 'New draft' and every study Start adds a permanent row
findings.detail: The drafts list (#/creatives/write) has rows that only open a draft; there is no Delete, archive or 'saved to log' status anywhere in crwrite.js. 'New draft' writes an empty 'Untitled' record immediately, and studies create a new draft on each Start, so abandoned and already-saved drafts pile up forever on the device with no way to remove them.
findings.evidence: grep -i 'delet|remove|.del(' js/modules/crwrite.js -> no match; js/modules/crwrite.js:75 (New draft creates immediately), :83-88 (row = open only); shots/creatives/n/dense-mac-write.png | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): js/modules/crwrite.js:71-91 has no delete; drafts list grew 2 -> 4 in this run
findings.fix: Add a row menu (Delete with confirm, through KOS.ui.confirm danger), mark drafts already saved to the Practice Log ('Saved · 2 Nov'), and create a 'New draft' record only on first input.
findings.recheck: holds — js/modules/crwrite.js:71-91 has no delete; drafts list grew 2 -> 4 in this run

findings.title: Reopening a study's check shows a blank form and silently overwrites the earlier result (a pass can become 'Not yet')
findings.detail: 'Do the check' / 'Check' on a work that already has a check draws both questions unanswered with no sign of the earlier answer, note or date.
